description: Election Commission - Declare that M. Kandhasamy and P. Murugamoorththy as member of the Manmunaipattu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Manmunaipattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of members and the nomination of replacement members by a recognized political party. The content focuses on electoral procedures and member declarations rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
